_comment: Shared family-office calendar. Seeded with real estate/guest/vehicle/staff/collection/vault ids for link resolution. Shape is Realtime-ready (row per event, stable id) for a future Supabase `events` table.

events.title: Monaco Yacht Week — Private Dinner aboard M/Y AGAPE
events.securityBrief: Close protection on Pier H; guest list soft-locked 24h prior. No press. Yacht gangway credentials only — coordinate with Yacht Liaison.
events.notes: Seated for 14. Chef Marco Rossi flying in from Dubai the morning of. Dress: black tie optional.

events.title: Art Dubai — VIP Preview Walk
events.securityBrief: Low-profile arrival via VIP gate. One CPO; no convoy. Avoid main entrance cameras during press hour.
events.notes: Priority booths: modern Middle East and secondary market Picasso drawings. Isabella holding acquisition brief.

events.title: Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix — Paddock Weekend
events.securityBrief: Aviation: ACJ330 into AUH private. Ground: Valkyrie for circuit transfer only — alternate SUV for crowd segments. Full CPO detail race day.
events.notes: Hospitality suite confirmed; Sunday race is primary. Lucien Baudelaire joining Saturday practice.

events.title: Q4 Family Board — Strategy & Capital Allocation
events.securityBrief: Closed session. Devices in Faraday tray at door. No external guests. Security Director on standby floor below.
events.notes: Agenda: portfolio rebalance, Bahamas island CapEx, Art Dubai acquisitions, 2027 travel slate.

events.title: Estate Guest Stay — Elena Varga
events.securityBrief: Guest already cleared. Soft access to guest wing only; master suite offline. Vehicle keys for Daytona SP3 released with chauffeur protocol.
events.notes: Overlaps Yacht Week dinner — Elena is on the dinner guest list.

events.title: Estate Guest Stay — Isabelle Moreau
events.securityBrief: Property Manager briefed. Gate codes rotated day-of arrival. Carlos Mendoza may visit mid-stay — confirm identity before gate open.
events.notes: Housekeeping prep 48h prior. Wine cellar access for tasting dinner Friday.

events.title: Deadhead — Dubai → Monaco (ACJ TwoTwenty)

place.name: DXB Private → LFMN / Nice Côte d'Azur

events.securityBrief: Standard aviation SOP. Manifest locked; ground transfer Nice → Monaco via pre-cleared car. No public FBO photos.
events.notes: Positions principal for Yacht Week dinner and Elena guest overlap.

events.title: Bahamas Island — Family Long Weekend
events.securityBrief: Island perimeter boat patrol on arrival day. Marine assets reserved for family only — no charter guests.
events.notes: Bucket-list adjacent: private cay snorkel + night on the water. Light staff footprint.

events.title: Private Dinner — Lord Harrington
events.securityBrief: Single CPO. Guest is known — standard estate protocol. No photography of dining gallery works.
events.notes: Pair Midshipman Proctor sword viewing with after-dinner coffee if requested.

events.title: Toronto Compound — Operations Review
events.securityBrief: Completed. Site Security Supervisor logged attendance; no incidents.
events.notes: Winterization schedule locked. Follow-ups assigned to COO.

events.title: Art Basel Miami — Pavilion Tour (withdrawn)
events.securityBrief: Cancelled — conflicts with Abu Dhabi F1 paddock weekend. Release hotel hold.
events.notes: Rebook interest for 2027 if F1 calendar allows.

events.title: Bucket List — Northern Lights, Finnish Lapland
events.securityBrief: Remote lodge; one CPO + aviation desk. Medical kit + sat comms mandatory. No social posting of coordinates.
events.notes: Ties to Finland Estate staging in Helsinki. Soft hold pending aurora forecast window.
